keySentence: She could not walk but still tried to be glad.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The doctor had bad news. Pollyanna could not walk. She cried but stayed strong. She could not walk but still tried to be glad.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The doctor came back with very sad news for everyone. Pollyanna might never be able to walk again on her own. Tears rolled down her cheeks when she heard the truth. She could not walk but still tried to be glad about life. She looked at a butterfly outside and smiled through her tears. Her brave spirit inspired everyone who came to visit her.
